relevance.rationale: Proves modular knots (closed geodesics in UT(PSL_2(Z)\H)) are isotopic to Lorenz template knots with trefoil linking number equal to the Rademacher function.

keyResults.statement: Closed geodesics on the modular surface lift in UT(PSL_2(Z)\H) = S^3 \ T_{2,3} to knots isotopic to Lorenz periodic orbits on the Birman-Williams template, with linking number given by the Rademacher cocycle.
keyResults.useForFolio: Connects SL_2(Z) geodesic cutting sequences to Birman-Williams positive-braid templates.
